name: bb-friends
description: A bb plugin to see friends' status and poke them, backed by a Cloudflare Durable Object.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix plugin install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix worker run typecheck && npm --prefix plugin run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix worker test && npm --prefix plugin test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
